title: dripstone and stuff
description: makes dripstone 3d in the style of actions and stuff
body:
LEGAL WARNING: I AM NOT ASSOCIATED WITH ACTIONS AND STUFF AT ALL!!!!!!! THIS IS A SERPERATE FAN PROJECT!!!!

Do you like actions and stuff?

Do you ever feel alot of 3D dripstone ppacks go a little too hard on the details?

Do you want 3D dripstone that works with other texture packs?

Yeah. me too.

So I made this!


Its the same style as Actions and stuff

Its not too much 3D

It should theoretically be compatible with other textures packs!

You just need to download it!
